channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Walkable Deck (Experimental)
item.description: EXPERIMENTAL - Walk around on Shipwright boat decks while they sail. Requires Shipwright.

item.title: Wilderlands Onus Moderatus
item.description: - Using One Hand as a dependancy, creates three inventory bar slots with one backpack slot open.

item.title: Crucibulum
item.description: Set a crucible in the forge and melt metal where you smith it

item.title: Fornax
item.description: The kiln between the pit kiln and the beehive kiln. Mud brick, firewood, and no iron at all.

item.title: Lunchbox
item.description: Adds storage containers which automatically feeds the player when hungry

item.title: Newfies Block Logger & Animal Limiter
item.description: A Robust block, entity, and item logger, with animal limiting!

item.title: configkit
item.description: In-game settings for your mods, without ImGui (alternative to configlib).

item.title: Backpack Quick Access
item.description: Easy to Use Modular Backpack Quick Slots

item.title: Shepherd's Herding
item.description: An Addon for Adventurers Walking stick that allows the player to dynamically herd their Livestock

item.title: Riley's Classes
item.description: Addon for Aldi's Classes, makes classes interact with other mods and adds new ones!

item.title: Umbrella
item.description: Adds an umbrella that prevents you from getting wet in the rain.

item.title: Experiment Player Model
item.description: Adds a playable Expie species from C:U and Gunsaw.

item.title: Temporal Storage
item.description: A simple Storage Solution using the power of Temporal Entanglement! (Now with actual sorting~)

item.title: xSkills Tailoring Aldi's Classes
item.description: A fork of "X-Skills Tailoring" made to be compatible with "xSkills X Aldi's Classes".

item.title: Komet - Performance Mod
item.description: Komet is a performance mod, which optimizes the Vintage Story rendering.

item.title: VintageStory D'Août
item.description: This modpack contains all the mods used on the Vintage Story server hosted by Pressea.

item.title: Seraph Leveling ReClassed
item.description: Level up and gain traits in a vanilla-friendly way, with additional mod support

item.title: VintageSymphonyForked
item.description: Vintage Symphony is a situation-aware music engine replacement for Vintage Story, forked for 1.22

item.title: The Basics - Roleplay (RP) Proximity Chat and more!
item.description: Configurable Roleplay (RP) proximity chat system, various QoL features, and more!

item.title: More Flowers - Pink & Purple
item.description: Add more varieties of flowers - Pink & purple edition

item.title: Riley's Classes RP Patch
item.description: An addon for Riley's Classes that rebalances the mod for RP Servers.

item.title: From Golden Combs
item.description: Adds Ceramic Hives and Langstroth Hives with Configurable Production Rates and Times

item.title: Force Character Class Change
item.description: Forces all players to reselect their class.

item.title: Yols Ore Obfuscator (Anti-Xray)
item.description: Makes Xray unuseable for players by sending fake blocks to clients

item.title: Slugcat Player Model
item.description: Adds a playable Slugcat species from the Rain World

item.title: Rift Traveler
item.description: Explore or close rifts, craft temporal tech, teleport home, and transmit cargo across dimensions

item.title: Scribe: Notes & Tasks
item.description: Items and stations to take notes and track tasks in-game. Pin to-dos on your HUD. Multiplayer-ready.

item.title: Crown & Coalition Server Tweaks
item.description: For details on content, please contact me directly via Discord.

item.title: Strike the earth! (WIP)
item.description: Allows to play as lore accurate dwarves and other races from dwarf fortress.

item.title: More Blood Thingies!
item.description: Adds all the features for bloodbread that should have been.
